summary: Phase 2 blocked on interval-splitting problem in nf_2var_existential_transfer -- the 4-variable existential transfer at StaviCompleteness.lean lines 2347/2429 requires either building the EF game bridge (~300-500 lines) or proving an interval-splitting zone match (~200-300 lines), neither of which exists in the codebase.

blockers.description: The sorry at StaviCompleteness.lean:2347 requires a 4-variable existential transfer for a 3-point configuration (u,x,t)/(u',x',t'). Zone matching via the (x,t) bridge does not preserve sub-interval type structure (the 'interval-splitting problem'). This is the core of GHR93 Proposition 7's game composition argument, which is implemented in Composition.lean but has no bridge connecting NF hypotheses to the game world.
approaches: A: Build EF game bridge (~300-500 lines) connecting NF hypotheses to existing game infrastructure
B: Prove interval-splitting zone match directly (~200-300 lines)
C: Restructure proof to avoid nf_2var_existential_transfer (e.g., temporal formula decomposition)
